subject: Next steps & proposed rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudlogix.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & proposed rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap so we’re aligned:
- Primary goal: proof-of-concept to validate latency and cost economics for search & summarization workflows against your 50M-doc corpus.
- Key stakeholders: you (Product), Tom (Infra), and your security reviewer (TBD).
- Must-haves for demo: end-to-end ingest, streaming summarization at 512 token context, and traffic-mirroring to a staging VPC.

We’d like to schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive (screen share + infra Qs) and propose a rotating cadence of demo windows to make it reasonable for your distributed team. Below is a lightweight rotation we find works well for multi-region teams:

Rotation proposal (3-week cycle):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 11:00–12:00 PT / Wed 19:00–20:00 CET
- Week B (EU-friendly): Thu 10:00–11:00 CET / Thu 17:00–18:00 HKT
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Mon 09:00–10:00 HKT / Mon 17:00–18:00 PT

Action items / asks:
1) Can you confirm who from CloudLogix should be on the technical deep dive (please include emails)?
2) Which week in the next 3-week cycle works best for your team as an initial slot?
3) Any constraints we should avoid (VPN windows, procurement freeze dates, etc.)?

I attached the post-call notes and a draft mutual action plan. Marcus and Priyom are looped in to help with demo logistics and any procurement questions. I can also post a Calendly link with three candidate times once you confirm attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-postcall-notes-0505.pdf, mutual-action-plan-cloudlogix.xlsx

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudlogix.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 17:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & proposed rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks Monica — great summary. We’re definitely interested. Quick notes from my side:
- Please include our infra lead Tom Chong (tom.chong@cloudlogix.com) on the invite — he’ll need to validate the staging VPC setup.
- Preference: APAC-friendly slots are best for our engineers (Singapore/Hong Kong mornings).
- Avoid: last week of May — we have a planned maintenance window (May 26–30).

Candidate availability from our side for the next 3-week cycle:
- Week A: limited (we have release prep)
- Week B: Thu 17:00 HKT works well
- Week C: Mon 09:00 HKT also possible but prefer Week B
I’m including Tom on this thread. He’ll add any infra-specific asks.
Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product | CloudLogix
elena@cloudlogix.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & proposed rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Quick internal —

Agree with the rotation approach. Two operational suggestions:
1) Offer CloudLogix two rolling options for the first month: (A) pick a single APAC slot and we do 3 weekly runs at that slot to onboard their infra team, or (B) run a split-week pilot (Week B then Week C) to capture both EU and APAC network profiles. Option A reduces coordination overhead; Option B gives broader coverage for performance comparison.
2) I’ll prepare the demo runbook and checklist (attached) and share a shared calendar invite once Monica posts candidate times.

If Elena prefers APAC mornings, I’m fine covering the late US hours for the initial run.

—Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook.md

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudlogix.com>, Tom Chong <tom.chong@cloudlogix.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & proposed rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Elena & Tom —

Thanks for the quick replies and for confirming Tom — welcome. Based on your preference for APAC mornings and the maintenance blackout at the end of May, here are three candidate times (I’ll hold each for 48 hours):

Candidate slots (all times in HKT for convenience):
- Option 1: Thu May 22, 2025 10:00–11:00 HKT (Week B slot)
- Option 2: Mon Jun 2, 2025 09:00–10:00 HKT (Week C slot)
- Option 3: Thu Jun 5, 2025 10:00–11:00 HKT (alternate Week B)

Please click the calendar link to confirm the slot that works best: https://cal.com/redwood/demo-deep-dive-30m

I’ve also shared an editable mutual action plan and the demo runbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3CsampleDoc — feel free to add any infra constraints (eg, allowed IP ranges, maintenance windows, required tooling). We’ll adjust the runbook to match your staging topology.

If we get confirmation for Option 1 or Option 2 I’ll schedule the meeting and send the invite with dial-in details + an agenda.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
